title: US Stock Picks — Multi-Screen Quant Shortlist (24 Jul 2026)

version_history.note: Publish new post: 'well-to-wheel meets farm-to-table' piece on India's ethanol-mandate feedstock competition reaching retail egg prices. Rules out the diesel/freight-cost channel using this blog's own prior diesel-vs-CPI-food correlation finding (-0.16, wrong sign), then traces the actual channel: ~37% of India's maize crop now diverted to ethanol, competing with poultry feed (55% maize by weight), tracked into a reported 35-40% YoY rise in egg prices (NECC data, Sept 2026 trade coverage). Cross-links this blog's own maize/ethanol/sugar posts and the recent E20 tailpipe-CO2 well-to-wheel piece for the borrowed full-lifecycle-accounting framing.
